arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import parse

@parse.with_pattern(r'\w+')
def word_convert(s):
    return s  # Don't uppercase

extra_types = {'word': word_convert}

# Test case-sensitive (default)
result = list(parse.findall('{word:word}', 'Hello world hello WORLD', extra_types=extra_types))
print('Case sensitive:', [r.named['word'] for r in result])

# Test case-insensitive
result2 = list(parse.findall('{word:word}', 'Hello world hello WORLD', extra_types=extra_types, case_sensitive=False))
print('Case insensitive:', [r.named['word'] for r in result2])
EOF
